name: ANSI/IEEE normally-closed limit switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for normally-closed limit switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The NC limit-switch form describes a reference continuous circuit opened at the documented actuation position. Drawing interpretation needs the travel condition and return action, particularly where the switch participates in a permissive.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Check states during rest, travel and final position.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Normally closed does not itself establish a monitored safety or fault-detection function.
